scope: Computer Control Phase 9C2+9C3 combined native macOS system chrome topology discovery for Dock and menu extras/status-item ownership
platform: macOS system-owned Accessibility surfaces: Dock, SystemUIServer and Control Center

safetyBoundary.cleanup: only the temporary compiled discovery helper is removed

expectedCoverage: the running macOS Dock process is resolved by OS bundle identity
the Dock Accessibility tree exposes one or more AXDockItem nodes
Dock item subroles, attributes and advertised actions are recorded diagnostically
running SystemUIServer and Control Center candidates are resolved independently by bundle identity
kAXExtrasMenuBarAttribute presence/absence, role and topology are recorded per candidate rather than assumed
the full bounded read-only Accessibility topology is recorded for each candidate
no native Accessibility action or input event is delivered
no public Dock or menu-extra API is frozen by this discovery checkpoint
